solution.title: Windows Always On VPN — Device Tunnel Before User Logon (IKEv2, Machine-Certificate Auth) via Intune

products.name: Windows Always On VPN — Device Tunnel Before User Logon (IKEv2, Machine-Certificate Auth) via Intune — Commercial
products.short_description: Deploy the Windows Always On VPN device tunnel — machine-context, IKEv2, machine-certificate auth — through Microsoft Intune so the corporate network is reachable before any user signs in. First logon off-network, off-net password changes, and pre-logon DC access, the Microsoft-native way. Self-guided, tested, a fraction of consulting cost.
products.description:
Connect the machine to the corporate network BEFORE anyone logs on

Remote Windows devices need the corporate network at the logon screen — for a brand-new user's first logon with no cached credentials, for off-network password changes, and for group policy, logon scripts, and domain-controller reachability before a user is present. This solution deploys the Microsoft-native Always On VPN device tunnel (machine-context, IKEv2, machine-certificate authentication) through Microsoft Intune as a Custom OMA-URI ProfileXML in device context — the built-in alternative to third-party Start-Before-Logon add-ons, deployed pilot-first and rollback-ready.

Run it yourself — simpler, cheaper, and proven

You do not need a consultant. The package hands you the field-tested method as self-guided, click-by-click documentation a competent admin can follow end to end — backed by ready-to-run PowerShell.

  • Simpler — exact, ordered steps with full navigation paths; every object you create is named and reused through testing and troubleshooting.
  • Cheaper — one fixed price instead of an open meter; a comparable consulting engagement runs well into the thousands per day. Reusable on every rollout.
  • Tested — a pilot-first method (Assess → Configure → Pilot → Validate → Expand) with explicit pass/fail gates, including the decisive pre-logon test.

What's inside

  • Solution Overview — why a device tunnel (pre-logon, IKEv2-only, machine-cert-only, one profile per device), how it's delivered via a Custom OMA-URI ProfileXML in device context, and where Intune ends and the VPN gateway head-end begins.
  • Requirements Guide — every prerequisite (Intune licensing + enrollment, supported Windows edition/join type, the VPN head-end, SCEP/PKCS PKI, root CA + gateway server cert, connection parameters) with how to verify and how to implement each if missing.
  • Implementation Guide — exact, ordered steps including the folded-in certificate lifecycle (Trusted Root CA then SCEP machine certificate), authoring the ProfileXML, building the Custom OMA-URI profile assigned to a device group, then pilot, validate, and expand fleet-wide.
  • 5 PowerShell scripts — deployment-readiness discovery, on-device pre-logon validation, a profile + certificate coverage report, safe remediation, and a pilot device-group builder.
  • Testing & Troubleshooting Guides with explicit pass/fail gates, plus field-proven Best Practices for the assign-once, repeat-everywhere model.

The repeatable way

Every solution follows the same repeatable shape, so each deployment feels familiar and low-risk — buy once, reuse the playbook for the next wave and the next project.

The bottom line

The corporate network reachable before anyone signs in, on every managed Windows device — delivered from Intune with a Microsoft-native IKEv2 device tunnel and machine-certificate auth, and proven on a pilot before you scale.

What you receive — every file in your download

This package is delivered as downloadable files you keep and reuse across unlimited devices — nothing is left out and nothing else is required:

  • Implementation Guide (PDF) — the complete, click-by-click solution: solution overview, requirements, step-by-step implementation, testing & validation, troubleshooting, best practices.
  • PowerShell Scripts (ZIP) — 5 ready-to-run scripts (read-only discovery/validation/reporting; remediation defaults to a safe preview):
    • AOVDT-Discovery.ps1 — Always On VPN device-tunnel deployment-readiness discovery across Entra + Intune
    • AOVDT-Validation.ps1 — confirm the device-tunnel profile + machine certificate are present on THIS device
    • AOVDT-Report.ps1 — Always On VPN device-tunnel + certificate coverage report across the fleet
    • AOVDT-Remediation.ps1 — safely fix errored profiles / missing device-group assignments
    • AOVDT-Set-ScopeTargeting.ps1 — create/populate the pilot (and production) Entra device group(s)

Delivered as a Word document and PDF, plus all PowerShell scripts in a single ZIP — yours to keep and reuse.
